sections.section_content:
Make 3 attempts at each of the following:
* Max set of **Single-leg Squats** (Left leg)
* Max set of **Single-leg Squats** (Right leg)
* Max set of **Dumbbell Snatches** (Left arm, touch-and-go)
* Max set of **Dumbbell Snatches** (Right arm, touch-and-go)
* Max set of **Strict Toes-to-bars**
section_notes: For squats, the set ends when the opposite foot touches the ground. Use a heavy dumbbell for snatches that allows at least 3 reps.

metadata.raw_content:
Make 3 attempts at each of the following:  
Max set of single-leg squats on your left leg.  
Max set of single-leg squats on your right leg.  
Max set of left-arm dumbbell snatches (touch-and-go).  
Max set of right-arm dumbbell snatches (touch-and-go).  
Max set of strict toes-to-bars.  

For the squats, a set ends when your opposite foot touches the ground or you rest excessively at the top. For the snatch, use the heaviest dumbbell that you can find and still get at least 3 reps. Warm up for each and rest as needed between efforts.   

Post reps (and load) completed for each set to comments.

sections.section_content:
Continue for as long as possible until you cannot complete 3 rounds within the 3-minute window. Every 3 minutes, add 1 pull-up, 2 push-ups, and 3 squats.

* **0:00-3:00**: 3 rounds of (3 **Pull-ups**, 6 **Push-ups**, 9 **Squats**)
* **3:00-6:00**: 3 rounds of (4 **Pull-ups**, 8 **Push-ups**, 12 **Squats**)
* **6:00-9:00**: 3 rounds of (5 **Pull-ups**, 10 **Push-ups**, 15 **Squats**)
* **9:00-12:00**: 3 rounds of (6 **Pull-ups**, 12 **Push-ups**, 18 **Squats**)
section_notes: This is a test of endurance and efficiency. Keep a steady pace to ensure you finish the rounds within the window.

metadata.raw_content:
*From 0:00-3:00, perform 3 rounds of:*  
    3 pull-ups  
    6 push-ups  
    9 squats  
*From 3:00-6:00, perform 3 rounds of:*

    8 push-ups  
    12 squats  
*From 6:00-9:00, perform 3 rounds of:*

    10 push-ups  
    15 squats  
*From 9:00-12:00, perform 3 rounds of:*

    18 squats  

Etc.  

Continue for as long as possible until you cannot complete 3 rounds within the 3-minute window. Every 3 minutes add 1 additional pull-up, 2 additional push-ups and 3 additional squats.
